title: Kaggle Business & Analytics Case Studies
short_summary: Collection of independent analytics and business case studies across domains
summary: A curated collection of standalone analytics and business case studies designed to demonstrate structured problem solving, data analysis, and decision-making across multiple domains. Each case study addresses a specific business question, applies analytical techniques, and delivers actionable insights supported by data.

components.name: Kaggle Cyclistic Case Study
components.objective: Analyze rider behavior patterns (time, day, month, duration, and trip frequency) to inform targeted marketing and membership conversion strategies.
components.business_value: Demonstrates the ability to translate a business question into structured analysis and produce actionable campaign insights supported by data.

components.name: Kaggle BellaBeat Case Study
components.objective: Evaluate how users engage with smart device data over time to identify behavior trends and product opportunities that improve retention and engagement.
components.business_value: Shows end-to-end analysis skills (cleaning, exploration, synthesis, recommendations) and communicates insights clearly for stakeholder decision-making.

components.name: Kaggle Binary Classification Competition
components.objective: Analyze drivers of customer churn and build a structured approach to predicting whether customers will retain or close their accounts.
components.business_value: Demonstrates analytical reasoning and applied modeling thinking—connecting problem framing, feature considerations, and evaluation logic to business impact.
